source.text: General Atomic report E-117-833 (Simnad), section 2.4: log10 P(atm) = K1 + K2 x 1e3 / T with K1 = -3.8415 + 38.6433 X - 34.2639 X^2 + 9.2821 X^3 and K2 = -31.2982 + 23.5741 X - 6.0280 X^2, X = H/Zr = 1.65, at the closed-form peak fuel temperature 1338.322 K of this 20 kW/m pin: 5.6762 MPa. The value is the case's gas pressure as FEED works it out (the temperature is the closed form's, not the mesh's).
source.check: FEED's tests/hydrogenPressure.test.ts evaluates the same correlation at four points against a separate script, and the UT-Austin SAR figure 4.3b is reproduced (1.56 MPa at 960 C for H/Zr 1.65).

coverage.domain: synthetic pin at 20 kW/m, U-ZrH-like hydrogen pressure for H/Zr 1.65 taken at the peak fuel temperature; FEED computes no hydrogen inventory and the report gives no temperature range for the correlation
